{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool coat with a relaxed fit and mid-thigh length, charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy woven wool blend.
Turtleneck knit top with a ribbed crew neck and hip-length hem, burnt orange (#CC5500), fine gauge merino wool.
Straight-leg trousers with a slight ankle taper and full length, deep olive (#3B4829), durable twill cotton.
Chunky leather ankle boots with a low block heel and mid-calf height, dark cognac (#6F4E37), full-grain leather.
This outfit works perfectly for a two-hour walk in deep frost because the layered textures and heavy fabrics provide essential warmth against the cold autumn weather. The warm burnt orange top adds a cheerful pop of color that stands out beautifully against the muted tones of a park setting, fulfilling her wish to feel cozy yet stylish. By keeping the silhouette relaxed with straight legs and a roomy coat, it ensures freedom of movement while maintaining a polished everyday look suitable for meeting friends."}
